description: This file is a C++ header defining utility functions and constants related to session server states and logging levels within the Rialto server manager's common namespace.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a SessionServerState enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a LoggingLevel from the service namespace to a RIALTO_DEBUG_LEVEL.

methods.name: setLocalLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the local log levels based on the provided LoggingLevels object.
